title: provide more city options for timezone configuration
line: The time zone picker now has a city search that finds big cities like Mumbai or Beijing and selects their time zone.
explanation: Time zones are named after one city each (Asia/Kolkata, Asia/Shanghai), and the time zone selector only lists those names, so a big city like Mumbai or Beijing that is not a time zone name can't be found; since the selector was redone with a map there is not even a search field. The shared selector (used by the Digital Clock's Add Time Zone page) now has a "Search for a city…" field on the map that opens a Kirigami SearchDialog. It matches every time zone's city plus the 411 cities of over a million people from GeoNames that aren't zone names, case and accent insensitive, showing country and zone; picking one selects that zone on the map and in the combo boxes.

+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+#
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: 2026 Niccolò Venerandi <niccolo@venerandi.com>
+#
+# SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-2.0-only OR GPL-3.0-only OR LicenseRef-KDE-Accepted-GPL
+#
+
+# Generates cities_generated.cpp out of the GeoNames cities table, so that the time zone selector
+# can find big cities that are not themselves the name of a time zone (e.g. Mumbai or Beijing).
+
+import io
+import os
+import urllib.request
+import zipfile
+import zoneinfo
+
+URL = "https://download.geonames.org/export/dump/cities15000.zip"
+MIN_POPULATION = 1000000
+# Cities, capitals and seats of administrative divisions; leaves out districts of a bigger city
+FEATURE_CODES = {"PPL", "PPLA", "PPLA2", "PPLC", "PPLG"}
+
+
+def main():
+    with urllib.request.urlopen(URL) as response:
+        archive = zipfile.ZipFile(io.BytesIO(response.read()))
+    lines = archive.read("cities15000.txt").decode("utf-8").splitlines()
+
+    zone_locations = {zone.split("/")[-1].replace("_", " ") for zone in zoneinfo.available_timezones()}
+
+    cities = []
+    seen = set()
+    for line in lines:
+        fields = line.split("\t")
+        name, ascii_name, country, feature, population, timezone = fields[1], fields[2], fields[8], fields[7], int(fields[14] or 0), fields[17]
+        if population < MIN_POPULATION or feature not in FEATURE_CODES or not timezone:
+            continue
+        # The time zone selector already lists the city a time zone is named after
+        if name in zone_locations or ascii_name in zone_locations:
+            continue
+        if (name, timezone) in seen:
+            continue
+        seen.add((name, timezone))
+        cities.append((population, name, timezone, country))
+
+    cities.sort(key=lambda city: (-city[0], city[1]))
+
+    path = os.path.join(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)), "cities_generated.cpp")
+    with open(path, "w", encoding="utf-8") as output:
+        output.write("// SPDX-FileCopyrightText: GeoNames <https://www.geonames.org>\n")
+        output.write("// SPDX-License-Identifier: CC-BY-4.0\n\n")
+        output.write("// !!! This file was auto-generated by cities_generate.py. Do not edit it manually! !!!\n\n")
+        output.write('#include "cities.h"\n\n')
+        output.write("#include <KLazyLocalizedString>\n\n")
+        output.write("const std::span<const City> cities()\n{\n")
+        output.write("    static constexpr City data[] = {\n")
+        for _, name, timezone, country in cities:
+            escaped = name.replace("\\", "\\\\").replace('"', '\\"')
+            output.write(f'        {{kli18nc("@item city name, used to search for its time zone", "{escaped}"), "{timezone}", "{country}"}},\n')
+        output.write("    };\n")
+        output.write("    return data;\n}\n")
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()

 #include <QTimeZone>
 
+#include <KCountry>

 #include "timezoneutils.h"
 
+namespace
+{
+// Case and accent insensitive form of a name, so that "sao paulo" finds "São Paulo"
+QString searchKey(const QString &name)
+{
+    QString key = name.normalized(QString::NormalizationForm_D);
+    key.removeIf([](QChar c) {
+        return c.category() == QChar::Mark_NonSpacing;
+    });
+    return key.toCaseFolded();
+}
+}
+
 QList<QByteArray> TimeZoneUtils::availableTimeZoneIds() const
 {
     return QTimeZone::availableTimeZoneIds();
 }
 
+QVariantList TimeZoneUtils::searchLocations(const QString &text) const
+{
+    const QString query = searchKey(text.trimmed());
+    if (query.isEmpty()) {
+        return {};
+    }
+
+    // Names starting with the query come first, then those that only contain it
+    QVariantList startMatches;
+    QVariantList otherMatches;
+    const auto matchIndex = [&query](const QString &name, const QString &englishName) {
+        const qsizetype index = searchKey(name).indexOf(query);
+        if (index == 0 || name == englishName) {
+            return index;
+        }
+        const qsizetype englishIndex = searchKey(englishName).indexOf(query);
+        return index < 0 || englishIndex == 0 ? englishIndex : index;
+    };
+    const auto addMatch = [&](qsizetype index, const QString &name, const QString &country, const QByteArray &timeZoneId) {
+        (index == 0 ? startMatches : otherMatches)
+            .append(QVariantMap{
+                {QStringLiteral("name"), name},
+                {QStringLiteral("country"), country},
+                {QStringLiteral("timeZoneId"), QString::fromUtf8(timeZoneId)},
+            });
+    };
+
+    const QList<QByteArray> timeZoneIds = QTimeZone::availableTimeZoneIds();
+
+    for (const City &city : cities()) {
+        const QString name = city.name.toString();
+        const qsizetype index = matchIndex(name, QString::fromUtf8(city.name.untranslatedText()));
+        if (index >= 0 && timeZoneIds.contains(city.timeZoneId)) {
+            addMatch(index, name, KCountry::fromAlpha2(city.countryCode).name(), city.timeZoneId);
+        }
+    }
+
+    for (const QByteArray &timeZoneId : timeZoneIds) {
+        if (!timeZoneId.contains('/')) {
+            continue;
+        }
+        const QString location = QString::fromUtf8(timeZoneId.mid(timeZoneId.lastIndexOf('/') + 1)).replace(QLatin1Char('_'), QLatin1Char(' '));
+        const qsizetype index = matchIndex(location, location);
+        if (index >= 0) {
+            addMatch(index, location, KCountry::fromQLocale(QTimeZone(timeZoneId).territory()).name(), timeZoneId);
+        }
+    }
+
+    return startMatches + otherMatches;
+}
